'''2017 Worlds Day 2 Charlie Arlandson LS Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Charlie Arlandson]] at [[2017 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Charlie Arlandson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2017 World Championship]]

* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
